description: Bogotá's open data portal groups 81 transport datasets from the city's mobility secretariat (SDM, 21 datasets), the TransMilenio bus rapid transit company (19), the bus terminal company (18), the urban development institute IDU (7), the Metro de Bogotá company (7), the road maintenance unit UAERMV (5) and the spatial data infrastructure IDECA. They include the road infrastructure inventory (carriageways, sidewalks, medians, bridges, cycle paths and surface condition), road maintenance interventions and a road prioritisation model, Metro Line 1 and 2 alignments, stations and viaduct, TransMiCable lines, stations and pylons, TransMilenio trunk routes and stations, SITP zonal routes, stops, depots, fleet and daily and monthly fare validations, a GTFS feed, terminal departures of vehicles and passengers, the city mobility survey, and road crash and traffic enforcement records. Coverage is the city of Bogotá. The portal runs on CKAN with an API; most datasets are free under Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 (38), Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 (14) or CC0 (11), and a few are non-commercial or unlicensed. Caveats: licences and update frequencies differ by publisher, and some series are single years. The infrastructure and transit data support urban network flow, capacity planning, hazard exposure and resilience studies of Bogotá's transport system. It complements the Colombian Aerocivil air transport statistics and the GTFS specification.
licence: mostly CC-BY-4.0, CC-BY-SA-4.0 or CC0 (varies by dataset)
